The car dying is the cheap part. The rest of the day is the bill.

A breakdown is not one problem. It is a tow, then a rental, then two days of asking people for rides, then possibly a hotel because it happened three hundred miles from your bed.
Your plan handles that part too. Roadside is included, up to three events a year. Rental reimbursement up to $250 per covered claim. Trip interruption up to $450 if you are far from home. The claims call to Ascent is what turns all three on.
